name: Tesseract Linux native libs
tagline: Symlink distro Leptonica/Tesseract/libdl names for charlesw/Tesseract NuGet.
description: InteropDotNet looks under $(OutputPath)x64/ for versioned .so names. This script creates those symlinks (and libdl.so beside the TFM output) from system libraries.

commands.blurb: Link libs into a TFM output folder after dotnet build

notes: Apt: libtesseract5 + libleptonica-dev (or libleptonica6) + tesseract-ocr-eng for eng.traineddata
MSBuild opt-in: PrepareTesseractLinuxNativeLibs=true on test/host projects (not packable libraries) runs this script after Build on Linux
